key_insight: This paper reports the first pre-registered, investigator-blinded randomized controlled trial (n=153, Jun–Aug 2025) that causally measures whether LLM assistance changes novice performance on tasks designed to model viral reverse-genetics work — providing rigorous, quantitative evidence about LLM impacts on novice laboratory capability.
problem_solved: Addresses uncertainty about whether high-performing LLMs can meaningfully improve novices' ability to perform laboratory tasks with potential dual‑use implications, informing biosecurity risk assessment and responsible model deployment.
method: Pre-registered, investigator-blinded randomized controlled trial comparing novice outcomes with and without LLM assistance.
N = 153 participants tested on a battery of tasks that collectively model components of viral reverse-genetics workflows (June–August 2025).
Outcomes: objective performance metrics and comparative analysis between arms to quantify causal effect of LLM assistance.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners and policymakers with empirical evidence to guide risk assessment, safety-oriented model design, and governance for LLM deployment in sensitive scientific domains. Results inform human-AI interaction strategies in high-stakes settings.
visual_elements: Study design flowchart: randomization, two arms (LLM-assisted vs control), investigator blinding — annotated with n and timeline (Jun–Aug 2025).
Outcome comparison chart (e.g., bar or forest plot) showing primary performance metric differences with confidence intervals — emphasizes effect size, not procedural detail.
Risk vs benefit matrix iconography: potential safety concerns, mitigation levers (policy, access controls, UX), and decision points for deployment.
One-line timeline + sample-size badge: quick visual summary of trial period, preregistration, and n=153 to convey rigor.
paper_title: Measuring Mid-2025 LLM-Assistance on Novice Performance in Biology
paper_authors: Shen Zhou Hong, Alex Kleinman, Alyssa Mathiowetz, Adam Howes, Julian Cohen
